articles.title: CZ says tokenized Anthropic is coming to BNB Chain on IPO day
articles.summary: Changpeng Zhao says Anthropic-linked tokens from bStocks, Ondo and xStocks will hit BNB Chain on day one of the AI giant’s Nasdaq debut. This follows a $500 million pre-IPO rush that comes with notable fine print.

articles.title: Another U.S. appellate court goes against Kalshi, building the industry's legal headwinds
articles.summary: Despite a Commodity Futures Trading Commission demand that prediction markets return to operating in all 50 states, federal courts continue to get in the way.

articles.title: Payward, the owner of crypto exchange Kraken, is buying its CEO’s venture capital business, Tribe
articles.summary: Sethi, who was appointed co-CEO of Kraken in October 2024, is also the chairman of Tribe Capital.
